## Mixed Data PCA (FAMD)
```{python}
#| label: FAMD

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import prince
import glob
import os

plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 120

DATA_DIR = r"~\OneDrive\Documents\GitHub\Math-4810_Capstone\data"

def run_famd_auto(X, var_threshold=0.95):
    # --- Datetime detection (safe, fast) ---
    for col in X.columns:
        if X[col].dtype == "object":
            parsed = pd.to_datetime(X[col], errors="coerce")
            if parsed.notna().mean() > 0.8:
                X[col] = parsed

    for col in X.select_dtypes(include="datetime"):
        X[col+"_year"] = X[col].dt.year
        X[col+"_month"] = X[col].dt.month
        X[col+"_day"] = X[col].dt.day
        X = X.drop(columns=col)

    # --- Numeric ---
    X_num = X.select_dtypes(include="number")
    X_num = X_num.fillna(X_num.mean())

    # Drop zero-variance numeric columns (fixes sklearn warnings)
    X_num = X_num.loc[:, X_num.std() > 0]

    # --- Categorical ---
    X_cat = X.select_dtypes(exclude="number").copy()
    for col in X_cat.columns:
        X_cat[col] = X_cat[col].astype("category")
        if "Missing" not in X_cat[col].cat.categories:
            X_cat[col] = X_cat[col].cat.add_categories("Missing")
        X_cat[col] = X_cat[col].fillna("Missing")

    X_clean = pd.concat([X_num, X_cat], axis=1)

    famd = prince.FAMD(n_components=min(X_clean.shape), random_state=42)
    X_famd = famd.fit_transform(X_clean)

    cumvar = np.cumsum(famd.eigenvalues_ / famd.eigenvalues_.sum())
    k = np.searchsorted(cumvar, var_threshold) + 1

    famd = prince.FAMD(n_components=k, random_state=42)
    X_famd = famd.fit_transform(X_clean)

    return X_famd, famd, cumvar[:k], X_clean


def famd_scree_plot(cumvar, title):
    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(cumvar, marker="o")
    plt.axhline(0.95, linestyle="--", color="gray")
    plt.xlabel("Components")
    plt.ylabel("Cumulative Explained Variance")
    plt.title(title)
    plt.show()
    plt.close()


def famd_heatmap(famd, X_clean, title):
    loadings = pd.DataFrame(
        famd.column_correlations(X_clean),
        index=X_clean.columns,
        columns=[f"Dim{i+1}" for i in range(famd.n_components)]
    )
    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
    sns.heatmap(loadings, cmap="coolwarm", center=0)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.show()
    plt.close()


# --- Run ---
os.chdir(os.path.expanduser(DATA_DIR))
results_famd = {}

for f in glob.glob("*.csv"):
    print(f"\nProcessing {f}")
    try:
        X = pd.read_csv(f)
        X_famd, famd, cumvar, X_clean = run_famd_auto(X)

        famd_scree_plot(cumvar, f"{f} — Scree Plot")
        famd_heatmap(famd, X_clean, f"{f} — FAMD Loadings")

        results_famd[f] = X_famd
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Skipped {f}: {e}")

```

## UMAP
```{python}
#| label: UMAP_FAMD

%matplot inline

import umap
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

plt.rcParams["figure.dpi"] = 120

def run_umap_plot(X, title):
    reducer = umap.UMAP(n_neighbors=30, min_dist=0.1, random_state=42)
    emb = reducer.fit_transform(X)

    plt.figure()
    plt.scatter(emb[:,0], emb[:,1], s=10, alpha=0.7)
    plt.xlabel("UMAP1")
    plt.ylabel("UMAP2")
    plt.title(title)
    plt.show()

# --- Run ---
for fname, X_famd in results_famd.items():
    print(f"\n UMAP for {fname}")
    run_umap_plot(X_famd, fname)

```
